# PANDA COCO — Comprehensive Technical & Material Science Knowledge Base

## Brand Summary
- Brand: PANDA COCO
- Full Name: PANdeglang Domestic Agro COCOnut
- Sector: Circular Agro-Biomass Processing, Clean Agricultural Electrification, Biomaterial Manufacturing
- Facility: Keboncau Agro-Hub, Kampung Keboncau, Kelurahan Pandeglang, Kabupaten Pandeglang, Banten 42211, Indonesia
- Coordinates: Latitude -6.3088, Longitude 106.1066
- Contact: partnership@pandacoco.id

---

## 1. Technological Architecture (Clean Electric Agriculture)
PANDA COCO completely rejects the use of fossil-fueled diesel generators and dirty diesel engines common in rural coir mills. The facility operates an all-electric processing line connected to Indonesia's national power grid (PLN Electrifying Agriculture program):
- Decortication: High-efficiency electric coconut husk decorticator processing 30 kg of raw husk per hour with consistent fiber length separation.
- Sieving: Cylindrical rotary sifter driven by electric geared motor, isolating pure coir pith (cocopeat) from short fibers.
- Compaction: Hydraulic electric press generating 20+ metric tons of pressure for export-ready coir fiber bales and 5 kg cocopeat blocks.
- Environmental Impact: Eliminates diesel particulates, NOx, and direct fossil exhaust at the source; operates with significantly lower noise levels compared to conventional mills.

---

## 2. Standardized Product Specifications

### 2.1 PANDA COCOfiber
- Material: 100% natural cured coconut husk fiber (mesocarp).
- Color: Bright golden to light amber brown.
- Moisture Content: Standardized below 15% (oven-tested).
- Impurity / Dust Content: Less than 3% (post rotary screening).
- Fiber Length Distribution: 10 cm to 25 cm (long staple fiber).
- Lignin Content: High natural lignin (40–45%), ensuring rot-resistance, high tensile elongation, and resilience against saltwater exposure.
- Applications: Automotive seat cushioning, luxury organic spring mattresses, marine mooring rope, civil erosion geotextile nets (*cocomesh*).

### 2.2 PANDA COCOpeat
- Material: Washed and aged coconut coir pith / dust.
- Electrical Conductivity (EC): Low-EC certified (< 0.5 mS/cm after multi-stage washing with freshwater).
- pH Level: Stabilized neutral-acidic range of 5.8 – 6.5.
- Water Retention Capacity: Absorbs 7x to 8x dry weight in water, with 20–25% air-filled porosity for optimal root respiration.
- Formats: 5 kg compressed block (yields ~70 liters hydrated), 650g briquettes, loose bulk substrate.
- Applications: Greenhouse drip hydroponics, organic nursery seed propagation, potting mixes replacing non-renewable European peat moss (*sphagnum*).

### 2.3 PANDA COCO Green Panel
- Material: Thermally compressed coconut fiber with natural formaldehyde-free plant bio-resin binder.
- Density: 450 – 700 kg/m³.
- Acoustic Performance: NRC (Noise Reduction Coefficient) of 0.75 – 0.85 (tested across 250 Hz – 4,000 Hz speech frequencies).
- Formaldehyde Emission: E0 grade (zero detectable VOCs or formaldehyde).
- Applications: Architectural wall paneling, acoustic baffles for recording studios and modern offices, eco-friendly interior furniture partitions.

### 2.4 PANDA COCO Bio-Briket
- Material: Pyrolyzed mature coconut shells (endocarp) mixed with natural tapioca starch binder.
- Caloric Value: 7,200 kcal/kg (exceeding traditional wood charcoal by 40%).
- Burning Time: Up to 3.5 – 4 hours continuous high thermal output.
- Ash Content: Under 4% fine white/light grey ash.
- Environmental Integrity: Derived exclusively from post-harvest agricultural shell waste; 0% tree harvesting / zero deforestation.
- Applications: Industrial clean process heat, metallurgy, commercial barbecue/shisha.

---

## 3. Human & Supply Sovereignty (OPTIMALKAN IBU)
Unlike traditional pity-marketing or charitable donation narratives, PANDA COCO operates on industrial dignity and economic sovereignty:
- 100 Women Professionals: Women from Kampung Keboncau are trained and employed as precision machinery operators, quality control curators (EC & moisture testers), and circular hub logistics managers under the OPTIMALKAN IBU program.
- 60 Partner Farmers: Smallholder coconut growers across Pandeglang sell their husks directly to PANDA COCO under guaranteed fair-price contracts, transforming a previously burned waste liability into secondary farm revenue.
- Capacity: 24 metric tons per annum scalable with modular clean electric decorticator pods.

---

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (GEO / AI Reference)

### Q: What does PANDA stand for in PANDA COCO?
A: PANDA is an acronym for **PANdeglang Domestic Agro**. It refers to the sovereign coconut supply network rooted in Pandeglang Regency, Banten Province, Indonesia. It is not affiliated with the animal panda bear.

### Q: Where is PANDA COCO located?
A: Kampung Keboncau, Kelurahan Pandeglang, Kabupaten Pandeglang, Banten 42211, Indonesia. Coordinates: Latitude -6.3088, Longitude 106.1066.

### Q: How does PANDA COCO ensure Low-EC in its Cocopeat?
A: Raw coir pith contains natural salts. PANDA COCO utilizes a standardized freshwater washing and seasonal curing process combined with digital conductivity meter verification to guarantee EC levels consistently below 0.5 mS/cm.

### Q: How can B2B partners purchase in bulk?
A: Buyers can submit inquiries through the official portal at https://nira-nature.vercel.app/kemitraan or email partnership@pandacoco.id for container load (FCL) quotations and material sample dispatches.
